[Section] Data Collection & Pre-Processing ::: Pre-Processing ::: Tokenization
[source_id=24] Tokenization is a pre-processing method which breaks a stream of text into words, phrases, symbols, or other meaningful elements called tokens BIBREF14. The main goal of this step is to investigate the words in a sentence BIBREF14. Both text classification and text mining requires a parser which processes the tokenization of the documents; for example:
[source_id=25] sentence BIBREF15 :
[source_id=26] After sleeping for four hours, he decided to sleep for another four.
[source_id=27] In this case, the tokens are as follows:
[source_id=28] {“After” “sleeping” “for” “four” “hours” “he” “decided” “to” “sleep” “for” “another” “four”}.
